description.value: Slivers Charters Salmon Sports Fishing is a guided charter operation based in Port Alberni — the self-proclaimed Salmon Capital of the World — offering day trips and multi-night lodge packages targeting salmon, halibut, and steelhead in the Alberni Inlet, Barkley Sound, and the outer west coast near Ucluelet and Bamfield. The business is run by captain Doug Lindores and caters to individuals, families, and corporate groups seeking world-class saltwater fishing on Vancouver Island. Touring cyclists passing through Port Alberni could book a day on the water as a memorable detour from the regional cycle routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms a real, operating charter fishing business based in Port Alberni, BC, offering guided salmon, halibut, and steelhead trips in the Alberni Inlet, Barkley Sound, and Ucluelet area, plus a lodge in Barkley Sound. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Slivers Salmon Sportsfishing' differs from the website name 'Slivers Charters Salmon Sports Fishing'; phone numbers and website URL are present on the website but absent in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Slivers Salmon Sportsfishing' but the website consistently uses 'Slivers Charters Salmon Sports Fishing'.
No phone number or address in OSM tags; phone numbers sourced from website only ((888) 214-7206 office, (250) 731-7389 mobile).
Website copyright footer reads '© 2022 Slivers Charters' — site may not have been updated recently, though content does not indicate closure.
No physical address available in OSM or on the website; coordinates place the record near Port Alberni but exact street address is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating fishing charter business with an active website; a legitimate attraction for touring cyclists exploring the Port Alberni and Barkley Sound area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The lodge component of the business is located in Barkley Sound (not Port Alberni proper); day trips depart from Port Alberni. Cyclists interested in a fishing excursion should contact Doug Lindores directly at dlindy@shaw.ca or (888) 214-7206.

wow_evidence: Guided salmon charters from the 'Salmon Capital'; booked charter day.
blurb: Salmon fishing charters from Port Alberni into Barkley Sound.
